description: Game members TradeShuttlePlanner binds to. Most of this mod compiles against the public API, so a rename would be a build error. The exception is TradeSystem.SimulateTradeShuttlePreviewExchange, which is private and reached by reflection: if it is renamed or its signature moves, the mod silently degrades to value-only output with no error anywhere. That single member is the main reason this file exists. The rest are members whose meaning - not just their existence - the mod's arithmetic depends on.

methods.name: SimulateTradeShuttlePreviewExchange
methods.why: PRIVATE, reached by reflection. The only entry point that returns the resulting cargo list rather than just its total value, which is what lets the mod name the items coming back. Renaming it degrades the mod silently.

methods.name: GetTradeShuttleCargoWorldPrice
methods.why: values both the outbound hold and the simulated return, exactly as the vanilla PROFIT readout does

methods.name: HasTradeShuttleAvailableStations
methods.why: skips orbits that will not trade with the player at all, before spending a simulation on them

methods.name: IsValidItem
methods.why: the gate deciding whether a station consumes an item; drives the dead-weight report

methods.name: GetItemBuyPrice
methods.why: price at the player's current reputation, for the where-to-buy sweep and its ratio ranking

methods.name: GetTradeShuttleAvailableStations
methods.why: not called, but Planner.IsShuttleEligible reimplements its filter (CanBeTraded, the reputation floor, the contraband bypass, and the Barter-mode proxy-corp exclusion). If this drifts, the dead-weight report drifts with it.

fields.name: ShuttleInMove
fields.why: refuses to plan while the shuttle is already out

fields.name: TradeShuttleStorage
fields.why: the hold being planned for

fields.name: Mode
fields.why: read, not written; the scan follows the player's chosen mode and only sweeps categories in Barter

fields.name: SelectedBarterCategoryId
fields.why: set to the category containing the wanted item, so the priority budget chases it

methods.name: CheckShuttleArrived
methods.why: called after unloading, exactly as the vanilla unload-all button does

properties.name: TradeMinReputationToExchange
properties.why: the reputation floor mirrored in IsShuttleEligible

properties.name: TradeShuttleBarterPriorityPercent
properties.why: not read in code, but the 60% figure the report's explanatory text quotes

fields.name: SpaceObjectId
fields.why: groups stations into the orbits the shuttle can be sent to

fields.name: OwnerFactionId
fields.why: resolves the faction whose reputation and prices apply

fields.name: InternalStorage
fields.why: the sale stock swept by the where-to-buy report

fields.name: PlayerReputation
fields.why: compared against the reputation floor

properties.name: CanBeTraded
properties.why: first term of the station eligibility filter

properties.name: TradeShuttleUnsupportedSellValuePercent
properties.why: the junk rate; ranks cargo the destination will not consume far below cargo it will

properties.name: ProxyFactionId
properties.why: Barter mode refuses to deal with the player's own proxy corporation, so its stations must not count as buyers

fields.name: CurrentSpaceObject
fields.why: the shuttle cannot be sent to the orbit it is already in

properties.name: InventoryWidthSize
properties.why: cell usage in the hold summary; also the icon width size passed to ItemFactory.ResolveIcon

properties.name: StackCount
properties.why: quantities in the returning-items and dead-weight lists

methods.name: View
methods.why: PLANNER WINDOW. Returns the item's ItemContentDescriptor, whose Icon feeds ItemFactory.ResolveIcon for the cell sprite.

properties.name: ItemClasses
properties.why: maps an item's class to the dropdown option that would prioritise it

methods.name: Configure
methods.why: HARMONY POSTFIX. The stock market item window; its itemId argument is how the mod learns what the player is shopping for. A rename makes the mod forget the target entirely and it becomes unusable.

fields.name: _lastTripReportPageButton
fields.why: PLANNER TAB. Cloned to make the third tab button that opens the planner window

fields.name: _unloadAllButton
fields.why: PLANNER WINDOW. Cloned as the template for the window's buttons and clickable station rows; being a HotkeyButton is why it is swapped for a plain CommonButton

methods.name: RefreshView
methods.why: the hold is changed underneath the open screen, so it has to be told to redraw

methods.name: Awake
methods.why: PLANNER TAB. HARMONY POSTFIX. Where the third tab button is built, once, from the screen's own serialized widgets and wired to open the planner window

methods.name: SetState
methods.why: PLANNER TAB. Drives the planner tab's Active/Inactive visual

fields.name: captionText
fields.why: PLANNER WINDOW. Fallback caption target and the source of the TMP font reused for the window's own labels.

fields.name: background
fields.why: PLANNER WINDOW. Copied when a cloned HotkeyButton is swapped for a plain CommonButton, so the swapped button keeps its native background sprite.

fields.name: _captionLabel
fields.why: PLANNER WINDOW. REFLECTION. The label that actually renders the caption; re-pointed on a swapped button and cleared so a set caption is not re-localised.

fields.name: _captionTag
fields.why: PLANNER WINDOW. REFLECTION. Cleared so OnEnable does not re-apply the original localisation tag over a caption we set.

fields.name: _interactable
fields.why: PLANNER WINDOW. REFLECTION. Seeded to true on a button rebuilt by the HotkeyButton->CommonButton swap.

properties.name: CaptionLabel
properties.why: PLANNER WINDOW. Reaches the LocalizableLabel to set a raw caption that renders and sticks.

methods.name: SetInteractable
methods.why: PLANNER WINDOW. Greys out the load buttons until a target good and a destination are chosen.

fields.name: _keyId
fields.why: PLANNER WINDOW. REFLECTION. Cleared on a cloned button so the HotkeyButton stops re-binding its 'G' key glyph. The button subtype is why the vanilla UNLOAD ALL clone kept showing a stray glyph: the panel is rebuilt on every enable, so it is swapped for a plain CommonButton instead.

fields.name: _keyId
fields.why: PLANNER WINDOW. REFLECTION. The key-glyph panel a HotkeyButton drives; its id is cleared and the panel destroyed on clones so no stray hotkey icon renders.

fields.name: _label
fields.why: PLANNER WINDOW. REFLECTION. The serialized localisation tag the label re-applies in Start/OnLangChanged. Clearing it is the fix for cloned captions silently reverting to 'UNLOAD ALL'.

methods.name: SetRawText
methods.why: PLANNER WINDOW. Writes literal rich text into the caption TMP without a localisation tag.

properties.name: Icon
properties.why: PLANNER WINDOW. The icon Image set directly on a display-only cell cloned from the item-slot prefab.

fields.name: _background
fields.why: PLANNER WINDOW. REFLECTION. The cell background image, restored to its normal sprite and made the click raycast target.

fields.name: _count
fields.why: PLANNER WINDOW. REFLECTION. Repurposed as the stack-count label on a cell.

fields.name: _normalBgSprite
fields.why: PLANNER WINDOW. REFLECTION. The native slot background sprite applied to a stripped cell.

fields.name: _durabilityBar
fields.why: PLANNER WINDOW. REFLECTION. Hidden on a display cell so no stray bar shows.

fields.name: _usabilityBar
fields.why: PLANNER WINDOW. REFLECTION. Hidden on a display cell.

fields.name: _statusIcon
fields.why: PLANNER WINDOW. REFLECTION. Hidden on a display cell.

fields.name: _modifiedIcon
fields.why: PLANNER WINDOW. REFLECTION. Hidden on a display cell.

fields.name: _statusText
fields.why: PLANNER WINDOW. REFLECTION. Hidden on a display cell.

fields.name: _hoverBorder
fields.why: PLANNER WINDOW. REFLECTION. Hidden on a display cell.

properties.name: Icon
properties.why: PLANNER WINDOW. The per-item sprite resolved for a goods/hold cell.

methods.name: ResolveIcon
methods.why: PLANNER WINDOW. Turns an item's content descriptor into the sprite shown in a cell, exactly as the vanilla item slot does.

properties.name: ScreenRoot
properties.why: PLANNER WINDOW. The canvas root the game parents its [UIView] screens under; the mod parents its own full-screen window there and draws it above with a high-sorting Canvas, since it cannot register a real UIView.

properties.name: Pools
properties.why: PLANNER WINDOW. Source of the shared item-slot prefab cloned for icon cells.

properties.name: ItemSlots
properties.why: PLANNER WINDOW. The pool whose prefab is the authentic item-slot cell.

fields.name: prefab
fields.why: PLANNER WINDOW. The item-slot prefab instantiated (not taken from the pool) to build display cells that inherit native sprites.

methods.name: GetFactionColorByReputation
methods.why: PLANNER TAB. Colour-codes each station row by the player's reputation with that faction, matching the game's own thresholds

fields.name: ShipCargo
fields.why: the source the shuttle is auto-loaded from

methods.name: AddCargo
methods.why: returns trial loadouts to ship cargo between candidate destinations

methods.name: IsQuestItem
methods.why: quest items must never be loaded; the vanilla screen blocks them too

methods.name: TryPutItem
methods.why: the actual load operation, same call the vanilla ctrl-click transfer uses

methods.name: Configure
methods.why: the in-game summary popup; a single TMP caption, which is why the full report goes to a file
